Semantic summary: sets BG2 scale, republishes the effect-state pointer at work+0x7828, resolves two draw routines via Func_080cef64 into routine[2] (indirect calls through the r4/ip _call_via_rN trampoline slots, never direct function calls), seeds a 64-slot particle pool at the fixed EWRAM scratch address 0x02010000 with randomized fixed-point positions and a sin/cos velocity pair, then runs 64 animation frames. Each frame conditionally draws one orbiting marker (state->0x1C==1, gated further by a double-draw on the first 4 frames), redraws every eligible particle (frame >= particle_index/4 + 4) at a table-selected sprite cell, on frame 8 fires a one-shot Func_080d6888/Func_080b5088 dispatch pair, and redraws a 5-column background reveal band whose formula (subtract vs add-then-subtract-32) is chosen by state->field_4.

The remaining 6 differing halfwords / 8 wrong instructions are exactly the family's already-documented (games/gs1/recon/en/main/080e01e4.json, note (b)) evidence-exhausted register-allocation-priority residual: two clusters of independently-computed immediate loads (a pool-load vs a shift-construct for the two Func_080041d8 arguments; a pool-load vs a small-immediate mov for the particle-loop's base-pointer/mask preload into r8/r9) land in a different order than the reference even though every value, register, and net effect matches. Per the family's prior investigation and this session's own declaration-order/block-scoping retries (all zero-effect), this is not source-shape-controllable without hand-forcing register assignment or instruction scheduling, which is out of scope.
No GS2 or external source was used; no other Golden Sun decompilation project was consulted.

compiler_decision.finding: The remaining broad-looking rows reduce to one reciprocal r8/r9 role choice between the persistent particle pointer and mask carrier, plus one independent literal-load/shift ordering. The allocator assigns both long-lived pseudos from the same low-register preference class; declaration, scope, operand-order, family-template, and compiler-axis probes preserve the choice or regress surrounding exact code.
